ssdTimingsGuide: Offline free SSD tokens are released daily starting at 3:00 AM / 4:00 AM. Batches are allocated hourly for that day's Darshan. Counters close as soon as the daily quota runs out (~15,000 - 20,000 tokens).

ssdCounters.name: Vishnu Nivasam Counter
ssdCounters.description: Located opposite Tirupati Railway Station (Highly convenient for train travelers)

ssdCounters.name: Srinivasam Complex Counter
ssdCounters.description: Located opposite Tirupati RTC Central Bus Stand (Ideal for bus travelers)

ssdCounters.description: Located near Alipiri Footpath Link Road (Ideal for pedestrian pilgrims)
